tools.name: vatstack_validate_vat
tools.description: Check a VAT number against the official government register. Returns whether the company is active and VAT-registered, with its name and address when the register gives them. Each check creates a validation record and uses one hit of the plan. Vatstack: POST /v1/validations.

tools.name: vatstack_list_validations
tools.description: List past VAT number validations, newest first. Filter by batch, number, type or request date range. Vatstack: GET /v1/validations.

tools.name: vatstack_get_validation
tools.description: Get one VAT validation by its id, with the register result and any error code. Vatstack: GET /v1/validations/{id}.

tools.name: vatstack_get_rates
tools.description: List standard and reduced VAT rates by country, including rates for digital products. Filter by a two-letter country code or EU member state. Vatstack: GET /v1/rates.

tools.name: vatstack_get_rate_by_ip
tools.description: Get the VAT rate that applies to an IPv4 or IPv6 address, from its geolocated country. Leave the address empty to use the requesting address. Vatstack: GET /v1/rates/geolocate.

tools.name: vatstack_get_hits
tools.description: Get the hits used this month and the plan capacity, for supplies and validations. Check it before a batch of validations. Vatstack: GET /v1/hits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vatstack_validate_vat · Private data: vatstack_validate_vat · Public sink: vatstack_validate_vat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vatstack_validate_vat · Private data: vatstack_validate_vat · Public sink: vatstack_validate_vat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
